Willkommen bei LunyMerch!
Als einer der größten Merchandising-Anbieter Deutschlands bieten wir Creatorn einen umfassenden 360°-Full-Service.
Von der ersten Idee über Produktdesign, Sourcing, Produktion und die Entwicklung von Creator-Brands bis hin zur Platzierung im Einzelhandel, dem Aufbau des Online-Shops, dem Fulfillment und der Rückabwicklung realisieren wir alle Schritte aus einer Hand. Gemeinsam mit unseren Influencern entwickeln wir Produkte und Kollektionen, die zu ihrer Marke, ihrer Community und ihren kreativen Vorstellungen passen.
Für unser weiteres Wachstum suchen wir einen Partner Manager - Creator & Merchandising (all genders).
In dieser Rolle betreust Du in Vollzeit eigene Creator-Partnerschaften und steuerst Merchandising-Projekte von der ersten Idee bis zum erfolgreichen Verkaufsstart. Du entwickelst gemeinsam mit unseren Creatorn neue Konzepte, koordinierst alle beteiligten Teams und sorgst dafür, dass aus kreativen Ideen erfolgreiche Produkte und langfristige Creator-Brands entstehen.
Wenn Du die Creator Economy verstehst, gerne Beziehungen aufbaust und gleichzeitig komplexe Projekte organisieren kannst, freuen wir uns darauf, Dich kennenzulernen.
Aufgaben

Creator-Partnerschaften & Akquise: Du bist die zentrale Ansprechperson für unsere Creator. Du identifizierst neue Talente, baust langfristige Beziehungen auf und entwickelst gemeinsam mit ihnen ihre Merchandising-Strategie.
Projekt- & Produktmanagement: Von der kreativen Ideenfindung über das Produktdesign bis hin zum erfolgreichen Verkaufsstart (Drop) steuerst du Merchandising-Projekte ganzheitlich und hältst alle Fäden in der Hand.
Shop- & Markenpflege: Du unterstützt unsere Creator bei der visuellen Weiterentwicklung ihrer Online-Stores und Landingpages, damit der Look und die Usability perfekt zur jeweiligen Brand passen.
Team- & Event-Koordination: Du arbeitest eng mit unseren internen Fachbereichen (Design, Sourcing, E-Commerce) zusammen. Gelegentlich begleitest du unsere Creator zu Events, um unsere Brands vor Ort zu unterstützen und erlebbar zu machen.
Qualifikation

Erfahrung: Mindestens 1 Jahr relevante Berufserfahrung in der Creator Economy, im Influencer-/Talent Management oder Merchandising.
Marktverständnis: Fundiertes Wissen über Gaming-Communities und die Creator Economy im deutschsprachigen Raum.
Kommunikation: Souveränes Auftreten, klare lösungsorientierte Kommunikation und ein sicheres Gespür für Menschen.
Arbeitsweise: Strukturierte, eigenständige Organisation - auch bei parallelen Projekten und engen Deadlines behältst du den Überblick.
Kreativität: Pragmatische Problemlösungskompetenz und ein Gespür für Trends, Designs und Community-Interessen.
Sprache: Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem/verhandlungssicherem Niveau, fließendes Englisch in Wort und Schrift.
KI- & Digitalkompetenz: Sicherer Umgang mit K.I.-Tools für Brainstorming, Text- und Bildgenerierung zur Arbeitserleichterung.

Founded in 2018, Quince was built to challenge the idea that nice things have to cost a lot. Our mission is simple: to make really high quality essentials for really low prices, produced fairly and sustainably. We believe everyone deserves exceptional craftsmanship and timeless design without the traditional markups. Quince is a direct-to-consumer (DTC) model that cuts out middlemen and leverages just-in-time manufacturing to minimize waste and maximize value.
Quince is a tech company disrupting the retail industry by putting AI, analytics and automation at the center of everything we do. Our unwavering commitment to excellence and company values guide our teams and actions:
Customer First : We prioritize customer satisfaction in every decision.
High Quality : True quality means premium materials and rigorous production standards you can feel good about.
Essential Design : We focus on timeless, functional essentials instead of chasing trends.
Always a Better Deal : Innovation and transparency ensure value for both customers and partners.
Social & Environmental Responsibility : We commit to sustainable materials, ethical production, and fair wages.
Quince partners with world-class manufacturers across the globe and serves millions of customers. With strong investor backing and a focus on sustainable growth, we are a company that is rapidly scaling while maintaining a commitment to quality, simplicity, and radical price transparency.

At Quince, you will be part of a high-performing team that is redefining what quality, value, and sustainability mean in modern retail. We are a destination for builders, innovators, and operators to come together and challenge the status quo. Our collective ambition is bold. We are creating an entirely new category and customer experience – one that democratizes luxury and provides high quality products at radically low prices. That mission demands a world-class team committed to excellence.
If you are motivated by impact, growth, and purpose, you will find a strong sense of belonging at Quince.
We’re looking for an experienced Senior Manager, Site Merchandising to own the customer journey across the Quince Germany site. This role sits at the intersection of storytelling, strategy, and data. You’ll be responsible for how products and content come to life on the site to attract, engage, and convert customers.
Beyond optimizing the onsite experience, this role will take a leading position in SEO and organic growth, leveraging content and site merchandising tools to drive awareness, discovery, and traffic. You’ll use insights and data to ensure Quince’s unique value proposition shines through every page, from homepage to product detail.
This role will participate in shaping our growth in Germany through leveraging our global tools and processes, helping improve them and developing impactful localization strategy and tactics across web and app.
You’ll partner closely with Marketing, Creative, Category Management, and Engineering to ensure site merchandising supports both brand and business goals.

Lead the end-to-end merchandising strategy for the Quince Germany website and mobile apps, ensuring a seamless and inspiring customer experience.
Manage and optimize merchandising tools and platforms that power product discovery, personalization, and site and app performance.
Collaborate cross-functionally with Merchandising, Marketing, Creative, and Data teams to align onsite experiences with seasonal campaigns, assortment shifts, and brand priorities.
Partner with global teams to ensure improvements to tooling, automation, merchandising best practices can be easily adopted in the region as well as improving our key metrics.

Own site merchandising calendar and execution for key selling moments (e.g., Black Friday/Cyber Monday, holiday, new launches).
Drive best practices in product storytelling, cross-selling, and navigation to improve engagement and conversion.
Partner with Engineering and Data teams to implement content automation, metadata structuring, and semantic optimization that improve site crawlability and ranking in AI search results.

Strong organizational skills and the ability to handle multiple priorities in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.

Thrive Market was founded in 2014 with a mission to make healthy and sustainable living easy and affordable for everyone. As an online, membership-based market, we deliver the highest quality healthy, and sustainable products at member-only prices, while matching every paid membership with a free one for someone in need.

Every day, we leverage innovative technology and member-first thinking to help our over 1,700,000+ members find better products, support better brands, and build a better world in the process. We are also a Certified B Corporation, a Public Benefit Corporation, and a Climate Neutral Certified company.

Join us as we bring healthy and sustainable living to millions of Americans in the years to come. The Role We are looking for a proactive, hands-on Director of Finance, Merchandising to own and help drive top-line and margin growth.

As the owner of all aspects of Product Revenue, our largest revenue stream, and product gross margin, you will lead budgeting, forecasting/pacing, and the monthly close, and drive the analysis of strategic projects that grow product revenue and gross margin.

You will become a catalog and brand expert and the go-to resource for understanding product discovery, pricing, basket composition, and the margin dynamics that inform and guide our merchandising strategy.

You will serve as the primary finance business partner to the Merchandising team, working closely and cross-functionally with Data, Product, Marketing, and Operations, to build the financial models and analyses that help your partners make the best strategic decisions to drive revenue growth and margin expansion.You will also own the financial partnership on new initiative launches end to end, working alongside business leadership from opportunity sizing, scenario and sensitivity analyses, go-to-market strategy and the definition and tracking of success criteria.

Strong data fluency is an important component of the role.

You will partner closely with our Data Analytics team, self-serving in the data warehouse where needed, designing reporting outputs that generate insights, and advising on metric definitions and UAT, acting as the intermediary who brings business context to the data partners and data context to the business partners.

Ultimately, you will construct the data-driven narrative around how Merchandising drives top-line growth and profitability for Board and Executive audiences.

Our ideal candidate is extremely analytical and solution-oriented, enjoys working cross-functionally and building strong business partnerships, and thrives in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment. Responsibilities
Lead all aspects of the bottoms-up modeling and forecasting of Product Revenue and Margin for the annual budget, re-forecasts, rolling projections, and ad-hoc strategic initiatives.
Partner with business leadership to own financials of new initiative launches, from opportunity sizing, scenario and sensitivity analyses, and strategic review through go-to-market strategy and the definition and tracking of success criteria.
Provide detailed, insightful monthly financial reporting and variance analysis (actuals vs. forecast) with commentary on key drivers for the Board, Executives, and business partners.
Own and monitor the relevant customer and merchandising KPIs, including order frequency, AOV, basket composition, pricing competitiveness and inflation, product gross margin, and product contribution margin.
Lead promotional analysis, evaluating the effectiveness and margin impact of promotions and shaping future promotional strategy and spend.
Directly impact revenue and margin by identifying opportunities and making strategic recommendations on pricing (including regional and key-value-item strategy), catalog mix and expansion, partnerships, and member shopping experience.
Analyze new product-launch proposals and catalog expansion to ensure the business case and financial impact align with category, portfolio, and company targets, measuring the true incremental impact net of cannibalization.
Own Product Contribution Margin at the portfolio level and continue to develop methodology for estimating SKU and order-level contribution margin.
Partner closely with the Data Analytics team, self-serving where needed, designing reporting and dashboard outputs, and advising on metric definitions, UAT, and data quality so that reporting drives sound decisions.
Continuously review existing reporting and forecasting processes, identifying opportunities to streamline, standardize, and automate wherever possible to improve accuracy, timeliness, and scalability.
Build and mentor a team that is respected and viewed as thought partners by all levels across the company.

9+ years of progressive financial analysis experience in high-growth environments, ideally with direct experience in FP&A and/or revenue forecasting.
Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Economics, Accounting, or a relevant field; MBA is a plus.
Background in FP&A, strategic finance, investment banking, management consulting, or similar strongly preferred.
Prior experience with a subscription/membership and/or e-commerce business model preferred.
Advanced proficiency with Excel; expert at creating efficient, clean, complex, and dynamic financial models.
Strong data fluency: comfort with SQL (Snowflake or comparable) to self-serve against large, SKU-level datasets, and enough command of the data model to advise on report definitions and UAT; experience with product-analytics/experimentation platforms (e.g., Amplitude), BI tools, and AI-assisted analysis is a plus.
Ability to build very strong cross-functional partnerships, with exceptional communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills.
Highly analytical with strong attention to detail and a high level of comfort processing and analyzing large, detailed, SKU-level datasets.

Lead La Prairie-s global Store Design and Visual Merchandising strategy, ensuring a distinctive and consistent luxury retail experience across all physical channels.

Translate brand vision and commercial priorities into scalable design standards, merchandising frameworks and operational guidelines that drive execution excellence, elevate client experience and support business performance.

Partner across global and regional teams to balance creative innovation with governance, investment discipline and effective delivery.
**How you will create a beautiful impact:**
**1. Define and Protect the La Prairie Retail Experience**
* Shape and evolve La Prairie-s global retail identity, store design and visual merchandising vision across all physical retail formats.

* Define merchandising frameworks, planogram strategies and space allocation principles across key retail formats.

* Partner with global, regional and market stakeholders to drive alignment on retail design and visual merchandising priorities.
* Balance global consistency with local business requirements and market opportunities.
* Influence senior stakeholders and facilitate effective decision-making across cross-functional teams.
**6. Build Team Capability and Organisational Maturity**
* Lead, coach and develop the global Store Design and Visual Merchandising team.
* Strengthen capabilities across regional teams through standards, training and best-practice sharing.
* Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, continuous improvement and commercial mindset.

* Bachelor-s Degree in Architecture or Business/Marketing related field
